frozen_decision_rules.per_profile_label: STRICT_DOMINANCE only with complete source/risk/accounting/PIT evidence, all 252 valid pairs, bootstrap ci_low >= 0, strictly lower total fees and turnover, MDD_R3 <= MDD_R0, CVaR95_loss_R3 <= CVaR95_loss_R0 and zero hard violations.

interpretation_rule.cost_benefit: report whether R3 fees and two-way turnover are both strictly lower; minimum threshold0, magnitude always shown; counts alone do not establish causal fee benefit

interpretation_rule.strict_dominance_label: only if lower-bound interval for paired growth is >=0, both costs/turnover lower, net MDD not larger, and zero hard data/accounting/rejection violations; separately each profile; no claim of universal superiority

CVaR95.sign: higher is worse; report also signed worst-tail return mean
